column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3 Kederon: Domina and Mastema recruitments
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Please... no more fighting the elderly!
Please stop fighting them!!
You are... the nurse from the $$無料診療所$$, are you not...?
It is all right...
This battle...
is one we chose to begin ourselves...
Even if we go on living as we are...
we would only spend our remaining years in $$怠惰$$, idle days...
So instead...
I have long wished to fall gloriously on the field of battle...
Everyone!
Please stop fighting now!
It is all right...
This battle...
is one we chose to begin ourselves...
Even if we go on living as we are...
we would only spend our remaining years in $$怠惰$$, idle days...
So instead...
I have long wished to fall gloriously on the field of battle...
No!!
There are surely things that only the elderly can do...
There must be!!
There is no need for you to throw your lives away here...!
You too...
have the right to receive someone else's $$愛$$... You must...!!
This is... for the best...
Heh, heh, heh...
Make this joyless world a little more fun...
*Cough!*
You were called a nurse earlier...
Could it be that you, too, are a girl of the $$大神官$$'s $$血$$, able to wield $$魔道$$...?
And yet you do not seem to have horns on your head... *cough*...
And talk of $$愛$$—why, that sounds just like something a $$邪教徒$$ would say!
I use the power of items to provide treatment...
But more importantly, you...
You have looked very pale for some time now...
N-none of your concern! *Cough... cough cough!*
(Oh!)
(Is this...?)
...My name is $$ドミナ$$.
I have some knowledge of medicine, as well...
Would you permit me to join your company...?
Let her join
Do not let her join
I am old already... and $$ルピルピ$$ is quite weak as well!
She has come at exactly the right time!
If she is a $$医者$$...
then she is welcome with us!!
Thank you...
(That seriously ill person...)
(I simply cannot send her alone onto a battlefield...)
(Could this woman...)
(be plotting to threaten my position as an idol...)
(be an old-man fetishist?!)
$$ドミナ$$ has joined the party!
I see... Then I suppose it cannot be helped...
$$ルピルピ$$... Please take care of yourself...
But...
There must be things only the elderly can do...
There surely are!
Here...
You must not needlessly throw your lives away...!
Everyone, please...
please cherish the elderly more!!
Hmph! How ridiculous...
Those who have grown old and lost their strength should simply disappear...
That is the law of nature, is it not!
Because of us...
we seem to have caused you no end of trouble...!
You may be right. Perhaps there are still things I can do for this $$世界$$.
Well? Would you take me into your party?!
Let him join
Do not let him join
My name is $$マステマ$$! Though I am old...
I will not be beaten by the young ones yet...
After all, in my youth I was a $$千人殺し$$...
They called me $$マステマ$$, the $$雷神$$!
Heh heh heh... A $$千人殺し$$, he says!
$$マステマ$$ has joined the party!
I see...
So an old soldier is to simply fade away...
Then I shall return to the village and start over from the beginning...
Heh, heh, heh...
Make this joyless world a little more fun...
*Cough!*
But seriously... what kind of village is this?!
The village of $$ケデロン$$!!
That is not what I mean...
The reason this village turned out like this, too...
is that my father...
became this village's chief...
We need to hurry...
(Perhaps Father...)
(may not even see me anymore...)
